ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A population of goldfish in a large, isolated pond were studied in 1958 and again in 2008. The fishes' pigment level varied from pale white-orange fish to dark brown-orange fish. The color of each of the fish was recorded in the figure below.Which of the following best describes the fish population in the year 1958?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: Mostly medium-orange fish with some nearly white and some nearly brown

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: Mostly medium-orange fish with some nearly white and some nearly brown
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper graph is titled “1958 Goldfish Phenotype Distribution.” Its x-axis runs from “Light pigment” on the left to “Dark pigment” on the right, and its y-axis is “Number of Fish.” The curve has one main peak near the middle of the pigment range, with lower numbers of fish at both the very light and very dark ends. Reasoning: Since pigment ranges from pale white-orange to dark brown-orange, a middle peak means most fish were medium-orange. The lower ends mean there were smaller numbers of nearly white/light fish and nearly brown/dark fish.
